meta.expression: DESeq2 VST (roughly log2), blind, on the 276 main-cohort samples plus 24 KMT2A-rearranged cases; genes with at least 10 reads in at least 100 samples.
meta.deseq2: ~ wave + specimen_type + sex + NPM1_status on the 276 main-cohort samples, NPM1 wild-type as reference; apeglm-shrunken log2FC; significant = padj < 0.05 and |log2FC| > 1.
meta.tcga: TCGA-LAML (GDC STAR counts, GENCODE v36): ~ sex + NPM1_status on 111 main-cohort samples (31 NPM1-mutated, 80 wild-type), same cohort filters as Beat AML; apeglm-shrunken log2FC; significant = padj < 0.05 and |log2FC| > 1.

genes: Part of the NEK10/FTO/USP44 module: up mainly in the primitive-like (NEK10/FTO/USP44-high) subgroup of NPM1-mutated AML, close to zero in the committed-like one.

FTO locus / IFEX9. In TCGA-LAML coverage the rise in the NEK10/FTO/USP44-high group is IFEX9, a transcript starting in FTO intron 8 and spliced onto FTO exon 9; FTO exons 1 to 8 are not higher. Beat AML's gene-level FTO count includes IFEX9 (listed as FTO-007 in Ensembl 75).
Positive control: expected lower in NPM1-mutated AML, which is usually CD34-negative.
